name: GET /api/dialer/capacity - Concurrent calls in use vs. caps
description: Returns the tenant's concurrency: backend (redis | postgres), plan_cap, active calls, and per running/paused campaign its active count and cap. A tenant never holds more concurrent calls (dialing, ringing, in progress) than min(plan cap, telephony-key capacity, campaign max_concurrency): the plan cap comes from the tenant plan (default DIALER_DEFAULT_PLAN_CONCURRENCY = 10), key capacity from the telephony credential of the agent’s published stack profile, the campaign cap from the campaign. Slots live in Redis sorted sets with a per-call lease (atomic Lua check-and-take), falling back to an exact Postgres count under a per-tenant advisory lock when Redis is unavailable; a call that ends frees its slot.
